verificationHistory: Earlier complete background PGlite batch: 9 files, 66 passed, 2 skipped, before final four scope cases and two real HTTP route cases. Superseded by the final complete 10-file run.

A parallel partial service run passed 23 tests and skipped 2 native-only cases, but its HTTP file failed alias loading; a concurrent standalone HTTP attempt failed PGlite ArrayBuffer initialization during typecheck memory contention. Neither incomplete run contributes to accepted totals.

Browser harness initially used unsuitable pagination/switch selectors and omitted the site_config API mock; the latter attempted a GET proxy request rejected with EACCES. Final corrected synthetic runs passed; no production mutation was performed.
limitations: The two background pages are local candidates; there are no exact aliases for legacy PHP dynamic URLs, and no commit, push or deployment in this batch.
Scope type 3 exclusion was absent from the old UI and is an explicit extension using is_all=1 and actual eligible parent-product counts.
Admin pickers, validation and counts use visible approved root products (pid=0); public consumers normalize child product identity to its parent.

Decorative type 5/6 auxiliary rows must match the root promotion's scope; four positive/negative database cases verify selection, exclusion, brand and label scopes. Types 1–4 retain prior price semantics.

Deletion soft-deletes the root and same-promotion-type immediate pid children, including store derivatives; other-type children, auxiliary relations and history remain. Grandchildren are not recursively deleted, consistent with the old one-level pid operation.
Unknown write result protection is in-page only; there is no persistent cross-refresh receipt and manual list inspection cannot prove the original request succeeded.
Real restricted-role browser journeys, production media/product/activity scale and query plans, rendered product cards, full Linux CI and release acceptance remain open.
